subject: integration
name: Account standard (ACCOUNT_0_1)
summary: Defines how the browser's wallet asks an installed Account to list accounts, give public keys, sign and encrypt. The row runs nothing, connects to nothing and names no provider; only the browser's own wallet may call it, never a page. It states that a key never leaves the Account and that a signature not verifying against the public key first read is refused. It cannot check that an Account keeps the key local or signs what it was shown; that Account is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
